نرج (form I)
# نَرُجُّ (narujju) /na.rud͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of رَجَّ (rajja)
# نُرَجُّ (nurajju) /nu.rad͡ʒ.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of رَجَّ (rajja)
# نَرُجَّ (narujja) /na.rud͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of رَجَّ (rajja)
# نُرَجَّ (nurajja) /nu.rad͡ʒ.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past passive
